findings.finding: Q3 revenue has company-stated tailwinds that may top the 960 MEUR / +8.9% LC consensus. The H1 report says the 'more significant impact from increased sales prices is expected from third quarter' (6-8% increases, mainly from mid-year). Q2 grew 10% on volume. Kingspan's insulated building envelopes grew 8% in Q3 and Owens Corning insulation sales rose about 6% y/y. Against the restated Q3'25 base of 890, price plus continued volume would put Q3 near 965-980 MEUR.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1'26 (19 Aug 2026): Q2 revenue 1,000 against about 934 expected, plus a revenue-guide raise. The A share fell 4.1% and the B share 5.0% on margin and capex. Q1'26 (19 May, after the 11 May pre-release): +1.7%. Revenue beats have been sold here.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: consensus Q3 LC growth of 8.9% already embeds most of the price effect. If the beat were in the price, the consensus would sit near 975 rather than 960, and the A share's +9.6% 20-day run-up is mostly market and peer beta (OMXC25 and Kingspan moved together on 23 Nov). What is left is a small inference.

findings.finding: Energy inflation re-accelerated after the August guide: Dutch TTF gas rose about 60% in Q3 2026 (Trading Economics, 30 Sep) and is reported above EUR90/MWh in November. In Q2 Rockwool said 'the timing lag between cost inflation and our compensating price increases ... impacted Q2 margins'. That puts the 14.0% Q3 EBIT consensus, and the Q4 margin it implies (about 13.1% on FY 13.3%), at risk of another lag or a steer to the low end of 13-14%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin is the line this stock trades on. 20 Aug 2025 margin/outlook cut: -16.8% (A). 11 Nov 2025 EBIT-margin guide cut: -3.4%. 19 Aug 2026 revenue raise with margin only held: -4.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the gas price is public and the 13 Nov consensus was set with it in view, which is why the FY margin consensus already sits at 13.3%, the lower half of the guide. The transmission into Rockwool's Q3/Q4 cost line is a hypothesis; energy hedging is undisclosed. If fully priced, the consensus margin range would not reach 14.8% at the high end for Q3.
